brief: Today sees a mix of political dramas, from tight US primaries to Trump's decoy flight, alongside severe weather and disasters, while AI research explores new frontiers in human-computer interaction.
news_summary: US primary results are coming in with tight races, while Trump's secret evacuation from Air Force One raises scrutiny; severe storms hit the Midwest, a wildfire threatens Big Sur, and Colombia mourns an earthquake's toll.
papers_summary: AI research this week focuses on auditable AI-assisted writing, narrative keyframing for creative writing, and enhancing XR with haptic feedback, alongside new tools for code comprehension and data generation.
